title: Mini project: a profile card
summary: Combine variables, the box model, text styling, flexbox and transitions to build a polished profile card.

quiz.q: How do you centre a fixed-width block horizontally in its parent?
options: margin-left: auto and margin-right: auto (margin: 0 auto)
quiz.explain: A block with a set width and automatic left and right margins splits the leftover space equally. `text-align` only centres the text inside.

quiz.q: Which makes a list show without bullets?
quiz.explain: `list-style: none` removes the markers. Lists also have default padding, so many developers add `padding: 0` as well.

quiz.q: Read the variable `--accent` in the declaration.
quiz.explain: Define `--accent` once in `:root`, read it anywhere with `var(--accent)`.

quiz.q: Order these steps for styling the card sensibly.
lines: Set the page background and base text
quiz.explain: Start with global decisions (variables, page), then the container, then its contents, and finish with details like hover effects.

exercise.task:
Style the HTML into a profile card. The markup is done; write the CSS. Work in `index.html`.

- `:root` defines `--accent` and the button uses `var(--accent)` as its `background-color`.
- `body` has `background-color: #f0f2f5`.
- `.card`: `max-width` 360px, centred with `margin: 40px auto`, `padding` 24px, white background, `border-radius` 16px, a `box-shadow`, `box-sizing: border-box`.
- `.avatar`: 96px by 96px circle with a background colour, centred with `margin: 0 auto 16px`.
- `.name`: `font-size` 24px, `text-align: center`, `margin` 0. `.role`: `color: dimgray`, centred.
- `.skills`: no bullets, no padding, `display: flex`, `flex-wrap: wrap`, `gap: 8px`. Each `.skills li` has `padding: 4px 12px`, a `border-radius` of 999px and a light `background-color`.
- `.btn`: `display: block`, centred text, white `color`, no underline, `padding` 12px, a `transition`, and a `:hover` rule that darkens it.
hints: Work top to bottom: variables, page, card, then each inner part. Check often and fix one failing item at a time.
Centre the card with `margin: 40px auto`. The skills list needs list-style none, padding 0, then display flex with wrap and gap.
